title: FieldName
description: A bug field name that `bzr bug create` / `bzr bug update` accept for `--field` / `--field-json`, as emitted by `bzr field list` with no positional argument.

name.description: The field name a --field write accepts.

source.description: Why the name is accepted: `server` = the connected server's field/bug catalogue declares it; `bzr` = bzr models it as a canonical REST bug field; `both` = both.
